invariants.rationale: itemHeight is always set to the sum of internal font and selection drawable measurements.

invariants.expression: prefHeight == items.size * itemHeight || prefHeight == Math.max(items.size * itemHeight + style.background.getTopHeight() + style.background.getBottomHeight(), style.background.getMinHeight())
invariants.rationale: prefHeight is either a simple product or an adjusted value accounting for background (if present).
prefWidth accumulates via Math.max and additions, and thus should never be negative.
prefWidth is updated at exit to be at least background minWidth if background is present.
prefHeight is generally non-negative, being based on product or Math.max with non-negative background values.
